page.overview:
What is Armada Street?

Armada Street was a street in the Middle City of Bral.

This road stretched off of Grand Street and eventually terminated in a dead-end loop. Midway to this point it was met by the moot of Tower Street.

Like many of the streets in Bral, Armada Street was likely named after a class of spelljammer, in this case, the armada.
